decision_rule.freeze_reset_candidate_for_prospective_v: both Cliff's deltas >= 0.75, both permutation p-values <= 0.01, and all hard gates pass

hard_gates: exact IDP V1 frozen transport artifact available
all primary cohort rows are legacy LB -> current DL
structural reset changes only primary cohort in an in-memory valuation counterfactual
all reset candidate values finite positive integers
native_reference_groups: Frozen IDP V1 computed players with legacy_model_position=DL and current_valuation_position=DL.
Frozen IDP V1 computed players with legacy_model_position=LB and current_valuation_position=LB.
outcome_guardrail: 2026 realized Weeks 1-2 may be reported only as previously-frozen collection context. They cannot select a reconciliation coefficient or authorize deployment.

primary_cohort.definition: Current-live position-lineage candidates with legacy_model_position=LB and current_position=DL.

primary_falsification_tests: Migrated LB->DL residual distribution versus native DL residual distribution.
Migrated LB->DL residual distribution versus native LB residual distribution.
residual_definition: IDP V1 transported raw production multiplier minus its own clean new-model raw production multiplier.
selection_guardrail: Residual-retention sensitivity values other than 0 and 1 are descriptive only and cannot be selected from this analysis.

statistics.bootstrap_interval: 95% bootstrap interval for median difference, 20000 resamples, seed 20260929
statistics.randomization_test: two-sided deterministic permutation test of median difference, 50000 permutations, seed 20260929

structural_reset_candidate.interpretation: Remove the residual inherited from the legacy LB model while preserving the clean current-DL model and every later successor overlay exactly.
